simple.summary: זָקֻן (zâqun) means old age First listed occurrence: Gen 21 2.

definitions.full: H2208. zaqun זְקֻנִים noun plural [masculine] old age — ׳בֶּןזֿ Gen 37:3 i.e. a late-born son; ז ׳יֶלֶד 44:20 id. ; לִזְקֻנָיו (ילדה)בֵּן 21:2 , 7 (all J E).
definitions.rootNote: properly, passive participle of 2204 (used only in the plural as a noun);
